title: Services Agreement
text: SERVICES AGREEMENT. This Services Agreement is entered into on March 3, 2026 by and between Acme Corporation, a California corporation, and Globex Ltd. Payment Terms: Client shall pay each invoice within thirty days of receipt. Late payments accrue interest at one percent per month. Term: This agreement begins on March 3, 2026 and continues for twelve months. Governing Law: This agreement is governed by the laws of California.

title: Mutual NDA
text: MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT. Effective June 1, 2026, Initech LLC and Acme Corporation agree to protect shared confidential information. Confidentiality: Each party shall hold all Confidential Information in strict confidence. Termination: Either party may terminate this agreement with thirty days written notice.
